title: Remove a Team
instructions:
Write a function called `removeTeam` that takes a `MutableList<Int>` called `teams` and an `Int` called `team`.

The function should remove the given team number from the list and return the modified list.

For example, `removeTeam(mutableListOf(4215, 1234, 5678), 1234)` should return a list containing `[4215, 5678]`.
hint: Call `teams.remove(team)` to remove the value, then return `teams`.
